control_failures.control_label: atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work
integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.title: uncontrolled movement of TX-7001 during routine operation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control GAS_TEST_BEFORE_AND_DURING_HOT_WORK: the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work on TX-7001 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising hot work, specifically assessing and permitting hot work adjacent to live plant. TX-7001 (terminal switchgear) is in service for terminal distribution. The task proceeded during routine operation while the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 8 July 2016 an incident occurred on TX-7001 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during routine operation, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
